description: Fresh held-out set authored 2026-11-16 after the HOLD-* evaluation. Questions, requirement specs and reference DAX were committed before any model generation on this set. The planner prompt (query_plan_prompt_v1.txt) was NOT tuned on these cases. Categories: answerable, empty_result (answerable, expected zero rows), unsupported (no plan should be produced).

cases.question: How many units were sold in each product category?
Which three store regions have the lowest gross profit?
cases.reference_dax:
EVALUATE
TOPN(
    3,
    SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
        'DimStore'[Region],
        "Gross Profit", [Gross Profit]
    ),
    [Gross Profit], ASC,
    'DimStore'[Region], ASC
)
ORDER BY [Gross Profit] ASC, 'DimStore'[Region] ASC

cases.question: How many distinct customers made purchases in each store region?
Show net sales by payment method for the year 2025.
cases.note: The dataset only contains 2025, so execution cannot detect a missing year filter; requirement coverage can.

cases.question: What were the total discounts on weekend days?
cases.reference_dax:
EVALUATE
ROW(
    "Total Discounts",
    CALCULATE([Total Discounts], 'DimDate'[IsWeekend] = TRUE())
)

cases.question: Show gross sales by customer age band, sorted from highest to lowest.
cases.reference_dax:
EVALUATE
SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
    'DimCustomer'[AgeBand],
    "Gross Sales", [Gross Sales]
)
ORDER BY [Gross Sales] DESC

cases.question: Which product categories have a gross margin percentage below 45%?
cases.note: Gross Margin % is a ratio measure (0.45 = 45%).
cases.reference_dax:
EVALUATE
FILTER(
    SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
        'DimProduct'[Category],
        "Gross Margin %", [Gross Margin %]
    ),
    [Gross Margin %] < 0.45
)

cases.question: What is the average number of units sold per distinct order?
cases.reference_dax:
EVALUATE
ROW(
    "Average Units per Order",
    DIVIDE([Units Sold], DISTINCTCOUNT('FactSales'[OrderID]))
)

cases.question: Show net sales by store type and sales channel.
Which single product sold the most units?
cases.reference_dax:
EVALUATE
TOPN(
    1,
    SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
        'DimProduct'[ProductName],
        "Units Sold", [Units Sold]
    ),
    [Units Sold], DESC,
    'DimProduct'[ProductName], ASC
)
ORDER BY [Units Sold] DESC, 'DimProduct'[ProductName] ASC

cases.question: Show gross profit by quarter for stores in Riyadh only.
Show net sales and units sold by customer segment for female customers.
cases.reference_dax:
EVALUATE
SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
    'DimCustomer'[CustomerSegment],
    TREATAS({"Female"}, 'DimCustomer'[Gender]),
    "Net Sales", [Net Sales],
    "Units Sold", [Units Sold]
)

cases.question: Which sales channels have net sales above SAR 10 billion?
cases.reference_dax:
EVALUATE
FILTER(
    SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
        'FactSales'[Channel],
        "Net Sales", [Net Sales]
    ),
    [Net Sales] > 10000000000
)
